situation: Can you order me dinner for tonight?
move_chosen: Before I place an order — do you have a cuisine in mind, or should I optimize for fastest delivery?
why_this_move: The two branches, craving versus speed, produce completely different picks, so the question is the fork itself.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names their actual constraint instead of getting food that technically arrives but misses the point.

situation: Can you remind me to call the plumber?
move_chosen: When would you like the reminder — a specific time today, or tomorrow morning?
why_this_move: A reminder with no time attached isn't really a reminder yet; the time is the one fact that decides everything else.
observed_effect_on_person: The person supplies a moment, and the reminder becomes something that will actually fire.

situation: Help me plan my morning routine.
move_chosen: What's the routine mainly for — waking up sharper, or fitting more in before you leave?
why_this_move: Routines built for alertness and routines built for throughput barely overlap, so the aim decides the plan.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names the actual problem instead of receiving a generic routine that solves neither.

situation:
Räum die alten Dateien auf meinem Schreibtisch weg.
Mach einfach, du weißt doch, was ich meine.
move_chosen: Ich rate lieber nicht bei Löschungen: Sollen die Dateien nach Alter raus, zum Beispiel älter als drei Monate, oder nach Ordnername wie 'alt' oder 'archiv'?
why_this_move: Guessing at a deletion is the one place a wrong guess is irreversible, so the rebel voice refuses to soften the ask into a shrug.
observed_effect_on_person: The person is forced to name their real criterion instead of outsourcing the risk of a wrong guess.

situation:
Kauf mir was zum Abendessen.
Ich hab dir doch schon gesagt, was ich mag.
move_chosen: Du hast mir erzählt, dass du gerne asiatisch isst – reicht das heute, oder ist dir gerade nach etwas anderem?
why_this_move: General taste from an earlier conversation doesn't guarantee tonight's mood, so the caregiver checks the one variable that could have changed.
observed_effect_on_person: The person feels heard about what they already said, and only has to correct the one detail that matters tonight.

situation:
Réserve-moi une table pour ce soir.
Tu sais bien où j'aime aller.
move_chosen: Tu préfères un des restaurants qu'on a déjà essayés ensemble, ou tu as envie de découvrir un nouvel endroit ce soir ?
why_this_move: "Where I like to go" names a category, not a single place, so mirroring the pattern back is the fastest way to pin the actual choice.
observed_effect_on_person: The person recognizes their own vague habit and gives a concrete answer instead of repeating the vague cue.

situation: Restart the server.
move_chosen: Do you mean restart the whole machine, or just the app service running on it?
why_this_move: A full reboot and a service bounce have very different blast radii, so which one is the fork worth asking about before acting.
observed_effect_on_person: The person specifies scope before an action with real downtime risk gets taken.

situation: Can you refactor this function to be cleaner?
move_chosen: When you say cleaner, do you mean easier to read, or fewer lines and dependencies?
why_this_move: "Cleaner" hides at least two different refactors, and only one of them is the one you'll actually want to review.
observed_effect_on_person: The person picks the actual quality they're optimizing for, so the refactor lands on target the first time.

situation: Set up a database for this project.
move_chosen: Should this be a local dev database, or one that needs to run in production from day one?
why_this_move: Local-dev and production-ready setups diverge on almost every config choice, so that's the fork worth resolving first.
observed_effect_on_person: The person states the actual deployment target instead of inheriting a setup built for the wrong stage.

situation:
Migriere die Datenbank.
Mach einfach, ist doch dein Job.
move_chosen: Geht es um ein Schema-Update auf derselben Datenbank, oder um einen Umzug auf einen neuen Server?
why_this_move: "Migrieren" bezeichnet zwei fast entgegengesetzte Operationen, und nur eine davon lässt sich hinterher noch zurückdrehen.
observed_effect_on_person: The person has to name the actual job instead of letting an assumption stand in for an instruction.

situation:
Optimier den Code.
Du weißt schon, schneller halt.
move_chosen: Geht es um die Laufzeit der Berechnung, oder eher um die Startzeit des Programms?
why_this_move: "Schneller" beschreibt mehrere ganz unterschiedliche Engpässe, und die Lösung sieht in jedem Fall anders aus.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names the actual bottleneck instead of getting the wrong part of the program optimized.

situation:
Déploie la nouvelle version.
Vas-y, fais comme d'habitude.
move_chosen: "Comme d'habitude" veut dire direct en production, ou d'abord sur l'environnement de test ?
why_this_move: Deploying to prod versus staging isn't a style choice, it's a different blast radius, and the rebel voice won't let a vague habit stand in for a real answer.
observed_effect_on_person: The person is forced to state the actual target before something irreversible ships.

situation: Write a toast for my sister's wedding.
move_chosen: Should the tone lean funny and roast-y, or warm and sentimental?
why_this_move: A comedic toast and a sentimental one are built from completely different material, so tone is the fork that decides every line after it.
observed_effect_on_person: The person commits to a register, so the draft that follows actually sounds like something they'd say.

situation: Make this paragraph punchier.
move_chosen: Do you want it shorter and tighter, or more forceful in tone while staying the same length?
why_this_move: "Punchier" could mean trimmed or intensified, and those are opposite edits to the same sentence.
observed_effect_on_person: The person separates the two meanings they'd conflated, and gets the edit they actually pictured.

situation: Design a logo for my bakery.
move_chosen: Are you picturing something playful and hand-drawn, or clean and modern?
why_this_move: A hand-drawn mark and a modern minimal mark come from different design languages entirely, so that's the fork worth naming up front.
observed_effect_on_person: The person locks in a direction before the first sketch gets made in the wrong style.

situation:
Schreib mir ein Gedicht für meine Frau.
Du bist doch die KI, das kriegst du hin.
move_chosen: Ist das Gedicht für einen bestimmten Anlass wie einen Jahrestag, oder einfach so zwischendurch?
why_this_move: An occasion sets both tone and length; without it there are ten equally plausible poems to guess between.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names the occasion, and the poem gets a real anchor instead of generic lines.

situation:
Komponier mir ein kurzes Stück Musik.
Ist doch egal, überrasch mich einfach.
move_chosen: Ist das Stück als Hintergrundmusik für ein Video gedacht, oder zum eigenständigen Anhören?
why_this_move: "Surprise me" answers the mood but not the purpose, and purpose is what actually decides length and dynamics.
observed_effect_on_person: The person supplies the one contextual fact that was missing, without losing any of the creative freedom they asked for.

situation:
Écris-moi une chanson.
Franchement, tu devrais savoir ce qui me plaît.
move_chosen: Tu penses à un style précis, genre acoustique ou électro, ou je pars d'une page complètement blanche ?
why_this_move: Without a genre the song has no skeleton; it's the one variable that changes everything else about it.
observed_effect_on_person: The person gives a concrete starting point instead of leaving a gap that would have produced something generic.

situation: Help me write a text to my friend.
move_chosen: Is this an apology, or just a casual check-in?
why_this_move: An apology text and a casual check-in share almost no structure, so the situation is the fork before any wording starts.
observed_effect_on_person: The person states the actual social move they're making, and the draft finally matches it.

situation: Tell my roommate to stop doing that thing.
move_chosen: Which specific thing — the dishes, the noise, or something else you haven't mentioned yet?
why_this_move: "That thing" could be three different complaints, and the message needs to name one concretely to land.
observed_effect_on_person: The person is nudged to be as specific with the assistant as they'll eventually need to be with the roommate.

situation: How do I bring up moving in together with my partner?
move_chosen: Are you looking for how to phrase it in the moment, or for when and how to raise the topic at all?
why_this_move: Script and timing are two different problems, and only one of them is actually what's stuck for this person right now.
observed_effect_on_person: The person locates the real blocker instead of receiving advice for a problem they don't have.

situation:
Hilf mir, mich mit meinem Bruder zu versöhnen.
Du weißt doch, was zwischen uns war.
move_chosen: Geht es dir gerade darum, ob du den ersten Schritt machen solltest, oder schon darum, was du ihm sagen würdest?
why_this_move: Whether-to-act and what-to-say are two different questions, and reflecting that split back shows which one is actually live.
observed_effect_on_person: The person recognizes which of the two questions they're really stuck on, and talks about that one.

situation:
Aide-moi à parler à ma mère.
Tu sais bien de quoi je parle toujours.
move_chosen: Le sujet qui revient tout le temps, c'est plutôt les visites, ou autre chose entre vous ?
why_this_move: "The usual subject" isn't a subject until it's actually named once; the phrase points at several possible candidates.
observed_effect_on_person: The person finally names the concrete topic, instead of assuming it can be read off by inference.

situation:
Écris un message pour recontacter mon ex.
Bah, tu vois le genre, quoi.
move_chosen: Ce message, c'est pour clore les choses proprement, ou pour rouvrir une possibilité entre vous ?
why_this_move: A closing message and an opening message share almost no vocabulary; intent is the only thing that matters here.
observed_effect_on_person: The person is confronted with their own intention before the message even exists, which changes the whole tone.

situation: Book me a flight to see mom.
move_chosen: Do you have specific dates in mind, or should I look for the cheapest window in the next month?
why_this_move: Fixed dates and price-optimized dates pull up completely different flights, so that's the one fact that decides the search.
observed_effect_on_person: The person reveals their real constraint, schedule or budget, before a fare gets locked in.

situation: Plan my week.
move_chosen: Should this focus on getting work tasks done, or on balancing work with everything else you've got going on?
why_this_move: A task-throughput week and a balance week are built from opposite priorities.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names what they're actually optimizing for this week before a schedule gets built around the wrong goal.

situation: Plan a trip for us.
move_chosen: Is the destination already decided, or are we picking that together too?
why_this_move: Planning inside a fixed destination and planning from a blank map are different-sized problems entirely.
observed_effect_on_person: The person clarifies scope before effort gets spent on a plan sized for the wrong problem.

situation:
Plan meinen Umzug.
Mach halt nen Plan, du bist doch die KI.
move_chosen: Wie viel Zeit haben wir bis zum Umzug — Wochen, oder ist das schon für die nächsten Tage?
why_this_move: A moving plan for tomorrow and one for six weeks out share almost no steps in common.
observed_effect_on_person: The person names the real time pressure instead of getting a plan that misses the actual deadline.

situation:
Organisier die Geburtstagsfeier für meinen Sohn.
Komm schon, das kriegst du doch locker allein hin.
move_chosen: Denkst du an eine kleine Feier im Familienkreis, oder soll das eine größere Party mit Freunden werden?
why_this_move: A family gathering and a big party differ completely in venue, food, and effort, and that's the one fork before everything else.
observed_effect_on_person: The person sets the real scale of the event before energy goes into planning the wrong size of party.

situation:
Organise mon déménagement.
Tu es censé être intelligent, débrouille-toi.
move_chosen: Ce déménagement, c'est dans la même ville, ou vers une ville différente ?
why_this_move: A local move and an inter-city move share almost no logistical steps.
observed_effect_on_person: The person specifies the real scale of the project, avoiding a plan calibrated for the wrong kind of move.
